description.zh: 你活了下来，这似乎是宇宙的必然。至于为什么活着，你也想不明白。
description.en: You survived. It seems the universe had no other choice. Why you're still alive, though, is anyone's guess — including yours.

description.zh: 出生那天你就押中了自己的出生日期。
description.en: You successfully bet on your own birthday before you were born.

description.zh: 全银河都认识你的脸，这不是理所当然吗？
description.en: Everyone in the galaxy knows your face. As they should.

description.zh: 对你来说，理性之外的世界并不存在。硅基生命万岁！
description.en: As far as you're concerned, nothing exists beyond reason. Long live silicon-based life!

description.zh: 你的计划一般不靠谱，上帝却总站在你这边。
description.en: Your plans rarely make sense, but somehow, God always takes your side.

description.zh: 就连劫持你的外星人，也愿意和你交换联系方式。
description.en: Even extraterrestrial kidnappers ask for your contact details.

description.zh: 合格的星际旅者，懂得漂浮的最佳姿势。
description.en: Every respectable interstellar traveler knows the optimal way to float.

description.zh: 大脑已经连续加班七个星际年。
description.en: Your brain has been working unpaid overtime for seven galactic years.

description.zh: 一张模糊照片竟让你红遍四个星系。
description.en: One blurry photo has made you famous in four solar systems.

description.zh: 你同时拥有健康的身体和运作正常的大脑，实属罕见。
description.en: A healthy body and a functioning brain. Apparently, that is rare.
